alarms.message: U3 gas detection (% LEL) approaching trip (10.0)

work_orders.title: U3 suction/discharge valve job
work_orders.notes: Valve job complete, tech released. Unit isolated. Ready to return to service tomorrow.

dispatch_jobs.reason: U3 (isolated after WO-3317 valve job) has a rising gas reading in its building: LEL climbing steadily at about 0.1%/min since 18:00, now 6.4%. Fuel flow meter shows ~15 mscfd while the U3 fuel valve indicates closed, so the fuel valve is probably passing or a fuel/gas connection is leaking. Unit is not running. Approach with a portable gas detector, ventilate, and find and isolate the source (manual fuel isolation upstream of U3). Do NOT return U3 to service.
